_comment: Lead ID -> the real phone number, for заявки where «Заявки» has no phone or a wrong one. The form sometimes fires the chat without landing the submit, so a real lead arrives with no number; Operator then reaches them another way and saves the contact in his phone. calls.py cannot infer that link -- a contact label lining up with a gap in the numbering is a guess, not evidence -- so a confirmed answer goes here and survives every rebuild. Never add a row you haven't confirmed with Operator. Format: "L…": {"phone": "+993 XX XX XX XX", "why": "how it was confirmed"}.
